source.content: @isTest private class CurrentBaseLocalRuntimeRequiredDatabase001Test { @isTest static void missingDatabaseOneContracts() { Database.AssignmentRuleHeader assignment = new Database.AssignmentRuleHeader(); assignment.AssignmentRuleId = '01Q000000000001'; assignment.UseDefaultRule = true; Object assignmentCopy = assignment.clone(); System.assertEquals('01Q000000000001', assignmentCopy.AssignmentRuleId); System.assertEquals(true, assignmentCopy.UseDefaultRule); Database.Cursor cursor = new Database.Cursor(); System.assertNotEquals(null, cursor); System.assertNotEquals(null, cursor.clone()); Database.CursorFetchResult fetchResult = new Database.CursorFetchResult(); System.assertEquals(0, fetchResult.getNumDeletedRecords()); System.assertNotEquals(null, fetchResult.clone()); Database.DeleteResult deleteResult = new Database.DeleteResult(); System.assertEquals(false, deleteResult.isSuccess()); Database.DeletedRecord deletedRecord = new Database.DeletedRecord(); deletedRecord.deleteddate = Date.today(); deletedRecord.id = '001000000000001AAA'; System.assertEquals(Date.today(), deletedRecord.deleteddate); System.assertEquals('001000000000001AAA', deletedRecord.id); System.assert(deletedRecord.equals(deletedRecord)); System.assertEquals(deletedRecord.hashCode(), deletedRecord.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, deletedRecord.toString()); Database.DuplicateError duplicateError = new Database.DuplicateError(); System.assertEquals(null, duplicateError.duplicateresult); System.assert(duplicateError.equals(duplicateError)); System.assertEquals(duplicateError.hashCode(), duplicateError.hashCode()); System.assertNotEquals(null, duplicateError.toString()); Database.DuplicateRuleHeader duplicateHeader = new Database.DuplicateRuleHeader(); duplicateHeader.AllowSave = true; duplicateHeader.RunAsCurrentUser = false; Object duplicateHeaderCopy = duplicateHeader.clone(); System.assertEquals(true, duplicateHeaderCopy.AllowSave); System.assertEquals(false, duplicateHeaderCopy.RunAsCurrentUser); Database.EmailHeader emailHeader = new Database.EmailHeader(); emailHeader.TriggerAutoResponseEmail = true; emailHeader.TriggerOtherEmail = false; emailHeader.TriggerUserEmail = true; Object emailHeaderCopy = emailHeader.clone(); System.assertEquals(true, emailHeaderCopy.TriggerAutoResponseEmail); System.assertEquals(false, emailHeaderCopy.TriggerOtherEmail); System.assertEquals(true, emailHeaderCopy.TriggerUserEmail); Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult emptyResult = new Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult(); System.assertEquals(false, emptyResult.isSuccess()); Database.Error error = new Database.Error(); error.fields = new List<String>{'Name'}; error.message = 'required'; error.statuscode = System.StatusCode.REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING; System.assertEquals('Name', error.fields[0]); System.assertEquals('required', error.message); System.assertEquals('REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING', String.valueOf(error.statuscode)); } }
